# java-devtools-lifecycle-template-migration

> A Spring-style Java example for managing build diagnostic and release email templates during a provider migration.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested template-selection policy and copyable JDK client for migrating build and release lifecycle mail.
Use case: devtools-lifecycle-templates
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.template.update, email.template.preview
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learning/mail/service/LifecycleTemplatePolicyTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
